tools.titleEm: with every step laid out clearly.
tools.lead: Pick a calculator to get a first read on your MEP requirements. Every input and result is shown in full, with nothing hidden.
tools.disclaimer: These calculators are not a substitute for full engineering design or a complete check against the current official tables and codes. Before acting on a result, verify it against the current regulation and your project's responsible engineer.
tools.vent.title: Combustion air supply
tools.vent.desc: Checks the room volume and sizes the combustion-air supply for gas appliances.
tools.pipe.title: Gas pipe diameter / ¼ psi
tools.pipe.desc: Estimates from the closest matching length and capacity in this version's built-in table.
tools.pipe.length: Run length to the farthest appliance (m)
tools.hp.title: Gas pipe diameter / 2 psi
tools.hp.desc: Picks a diameter from the higher-pressure table in the base reference file; have an engineer confirm it.
tools.chimney.title: Flue diameter
tools.chimney.desc: A first estimate based on flue height, connector pipe length, and appliance load.
tools.meter.title: Meter specification
tools.meter.desc: Shows the meter class (G2.5-G65) and basic clearances for the load range you enter.
tools.converter.title: Natural gas / liquid fuel converter
tools.converter.desc: Enter a value in either field and its equivalent updates automatically.
tools.download.title: Download Chapter 17
tools.download.desc: Open the edition you need from the source linked in the base file. Confirm the edition is still current before relying on it.
tools.bottomNote: The figures and tables in these tools were carried over from the supplied base file and are not an official sign-off at this stage; they should be checked against the current edition of Chapter 17 before relying on them.
